system.description:
Effect

When activated, the wearer can fly at half speed up to a maximum of 40ft high. If activated when higher than 40ft high, you glide down until you reach the 40ft height limit. Functions similarly to the Flight ability in regards to taking damage while flying.

Effect

Your basic attack splash now hit all targets within range instead of only enemies.

Effect

The Light attack deals Fire damage and ignites flammable materials in its radius.

Effect

When activated, the device now remains active for a week on the same shell.

Effect

Now boosts the spirit core values of your allies by 1000 instead of 500.

Effect

You may create two shells instead of 1 (costs more Fuel still).

Effect

The damage reduction is increased to 10.

Effect

Increases the range at which these goggles are active by 60ft.

Effect

Increases the radius of the device by 10ft.

Effect

A person may watch the recording by spending 1 mana rather than using a shell.

Effect

You can use the device to check objects to determine if they are corrupted with astra or safe to touch.

Effect

Adds a shield generator, granting the airship a 15 HP shield. This shield can be switched on and off, but can only be replenished by changing the fuel cell.

Effect

Adds a small star cannon that fires an arcane blast from the front that deals heavy attack damage for 2 AP with 120ft Range.

Effect

Your movement speed is capped at 25ft while this is in your burden. This weapon has an additional 5ft range and a 15ft threaten range.

Effect

Grants Nimble. Nimble: After attacking an enemy with a light attack on your turn, you may move 5ft. This movement only provokes attacks of opportunity if that movement would put you out of melee range of the target.

Effect

You gain a +2 Lancebreaker Power bonus against enemies wielding polearms or lances.

Effect

Grants +1 to guard but increases burden by +1.

Effect

You can use this before making an attack to move 10ft before making an attack that benefits from this artifice.

Effect

The distance of light emitted can be any distance up to the normal max.

Effect

Reduces the Burden of this artifice by 1.

Effect

This artifice is no longer counted as a kit and can thus be stored easily in non-combat inventory.

Effect

Your weapon gains 240ft range, but you don’t armor pierce when shooting at targets further than 120ft away.
system.source: Flo's Madness · Weapons + Artifices item mods

system.description:
Effect

You gain +5ft range on your weapon attacks and your threatened range becomes 10ft.

Effect

The range of the weapon is increased to 120ft.

Effect

You gain +5ft range on your weapon attacks and your threatened range becomes 10ft

Effect

Increases the light emission to 60ft.

Effect

You gain +1 maximum mana, but lose 1 guard and 2 block.

Effect

Allies can still teleport while in the area.

Effect

When you deal max damage with an attack against an enemy in an encounter, your next spell this turn costs 1 less mana (min 0)

Effect

Looking at a target within 30ft automatically reveals their mana %.

Effect

Once per turn after you cast a spell, you may make a Light attack for 0 AP.

Effect

You may have your attacks deal Elemental damage instead of physical based on your mastered classes. Bajiquan for Fire, Monk for Water, Sky Talon for Wind and Still Stone for Earth, Transcendant Lightning for Lightning, Five Harmonies for Holy, Black Oath for Dark.

Effect

The first single target attack made with this weapon per combat also draws the weapon simultaneously. This first attack has its crit threshold lowered by 1.

Effect

The range of this weapon is increased by 60ft.
system.source: Flo's Madness · Weapons + Artifices item mods

system.description:
Effect

You may also create Medium Shells (costs more Fuel still).

Effect

Allows a downed ally to be hauled on the underbelly of the staff. But reduces the speed by 10ft while hauling.

Effect

When you are the target of a Mystic Eye ability, you may spend 1 RP to negate the effect on yourself and reflect it back to the user.

Effect

You no longer provoke attacks of opportunity, but all attacks against you gain Half Pierce.

Effect

After moving, your range is reduced to 120ft instead of 60ft.

Effect

You may spend 0 AP to gain +20ft movement until the start of your next turn. Afterwards, your movement speed is halved until you put in a new shell into your leg.

Effect

On activate. Heavy attacks grant 2 stacks instead of 1.

Effect

When used during a rest action, the filter provides half the food needed for a basic rest (20u) provided a camping kit is set up.

Effect

Looking through the binoculars gives you Nightvision up to 120ft.

Effect

The first basic light attack you make with this weapon in a turn makes a Light attack against all enemies in a 45 degree cone up to range.

Effect

The first light attack you make with this weapon in a turn makes a Light attack against all enemies in a 45 degree cone up to range.

Effect

The first light attack you make with this weapon in a turn makes a Light attack against all enemies in a 45 degree cone up to range.

Effect

Increases the accuracy bonus by +1

Effect

You may use this weapon as one minor item such as an instrument or parasol.

Effect

Moving into the target’s threatened zone the first time in a turn counts as 1 attack for the requirement to activate Dueling.

Effect

You cannot be disarmed or parried.

Effect

Increase guard vs light attacks by 1, doesn't affect heavy damage.

Effect

When wielding two dueling weapons with paired duelers, your offhand extra attack counts as one attack for your dueling bonus on your main hand weapon.

Effect

The device now translates all words spoken near it, allowing for easier two way communication.

Effect

If you don’t use this weapon to make an attack during your turn, you gain a +4 bonus to your Block until the start of your next turn. You also gain a +4 bonus to your ‘damage’ roll when using the Parry ability.

Effect

Changes the Photon Shield effect to instead project a dome 5ft around you that grants the shield effect to allies against ranged attacks only. Does not stack with other equipped shields. Does not stack with other “Photon” modifications. May still choose to activate the original effect of Photon Shield.
